anchor_desc: Guard checking the account balance is large enough before withdrawing.

cases.name: unrelated_line_changed
cases.note: Editing the ErrInsufficient message leaves the anchored line byte-identical at the same position.

cases.name: lines_inserted_above
cases.note: Inserting a var and a guard block above shifts the anchored line down by four with identical text.

cases.name: whitespace_change
cases.note: Only the internal spacing around the comparison operator changes; tokens are unchanged.

cases.name: trailing_punct_added
cases.note: Adds a redundant optional semicolon (Go auto-inserts these) to the anchored line.

cases.name: variable_renamed
cases.note: Renames the parameter amount to cents everywhere, including on the anchored comparison.

cases.name: rename_and_ops_changed
cases.note: Renames amount to cents and changes the comparison from < to <= on the same line (Type-3 near-miss).

cases.name: anchor_line_deleted
cases.note: The balance guard and its body are removed entirely, so the anchor has no real target.

cases.name: boilerplate_trap
cases.note: The anchored guard is deleted while several similar `if a.Balance < X {` lines are introduced as decoys.
